admission.justification: The opening request-count and chunk proofs guard whole-catalogue expansion or a second per-selection card fetch while keeping real large queries admissible.

applicability: Initial comparison page reads and the card-read set in Changed or All.
conditions: Logical opening reads are summary, task context, outline, leaf-wide trees, shown-invariant cards and lane; cards use ceil(i/500) requests for i distinct shown invariants.
Cards wait until the leaf-wide tree read answers or fails and the catalogue settles, because Changed needs its code facts.
Compute the card set without the selection; an explicit selection adds its own subject read but no independent card read.
A selected subject outside that fixed set can show its heading/subject slot without cards.
The dashboard server request-head bound admits one 500-identity card query while retaining a finite head bound.
exclusions: Treating six logical read kinds as exactly six HTTP requests for more than 500 invariants.
Every possible task/host/chat/frame read as part of the six review reads.
Speculative subject reads or cards for all catalogue subjects in Changed.
